title: Qualify one candidate SHA with security, functional and visual evidence
goal: Collect the complete release evidence after blocker fixes and classify remaining Sonar findings.

in: docs/acceptances/ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md (only if a recurring gap changes the standard)
out: Treating scanner findings as proven defects without triage

acceptanceCriteria: Every unresolved Sonar issue is classified with disposition and evidence; Quality Gate OK and release rule on unresolved issues are met without waiver.
Go full tests, vet, race where supported, frontend type-check/lint/unit/build, dependency scans, core smoke and key security smoke pass for the same SHA.
Authenticated desktop 1440x900 and phone 390x844 screenshots, URL, console and loading/empty/error/forbidden/submitting outcomes are recorded.
Representative MySQL query/latency and connection evidence shows no obvious ordinary-enterprise bottleneck; unmeasured claims stay unknown.

commands: cd backend && go test ./... && go vet ./...
cd frontend && npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run build
runtimeEvidence: candidate SHA plus GitHub run IDs and Sonar analysis ID

statusNote: 2026-10-10: local qualification now includes authenticated full smoke (77 passed), screenshots/console matrix, MySQL fixture EXPLAIN/P95/connection evidence, migration rollback rehearsal and green frontend/governance gates. Remaining release blockers are hosted candidate-SHA checks, Sonar 26 classification, Go 1.26.9/native cgo confirmation, npm advisory refresh and larger enterprise-volume load.
